metadata.title: Pediatric Research Equity Act of 2003 (Pub. L. 108-155)
metadata.legal_basis: United States Code (2024 edition); binding statute. The official text governs; check for later amendments.
metadata.applicability: Created FD&C Act 505B; 505B(i) requires pediatric adverse event review and pediatric safety labeling.
